cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'PYEOF'
import paramiko
import json
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
sftp = client.open_sftp()
# Restore server package.json from scratch
server_pkg = {
    "name": "@wasd/server",
    "version": "1.0.0",
    "private": True,
    "type": "module",
    "main": "dist/index.js",
    "types": "dist/index.d.ts",
    "scripts": {
        "build": "tsc --noEmit || true",
        "dev": "ts-node-dev --respawn --transpile-only src/index.ts",
        "start": "node dist/index.js"
    },
    "dependencies": {}
}
with sftp.file("/opt/areloria/server/package.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(server_pkg, f, indent=2)
print("Restored server/package.json")
# Read root package.json and add type
with sftp.file("/opt/areloria/package.json", "r") as f:
    root_pkg = json.load(f)
root_pkg["type"] = "module"
with sftp.file("/opt/areloria/package.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(root_pkg, f, indent=2)
print("Added type: module to root package.json")
sftp.close()
# Rebuild
print("\n=== Rebuilding ===")
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && pnpm run build 2>&1 | tail -10")
print(stdout.read().decode())
# Start
print("\n=== Starting ===")
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("node server/dist/index.js &")
print("Started")
import time
time.sleep(8)
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:3000/health")
print("\nHealth:", stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
